Assess the words separately from the value of the narrative move they serve. A useful image, question or transition can survive a required rewrite of its wording.

For each finding, quote the exact words at their supplied zero-based utterance indices, explain the concrete problem, request a specific correction or editorial operation, and name what should survive. Distinguish a required repair from an optional refinement. An objective grammatical error requires repair even when the intended meaning is clear. An accumulation of individually intelligible phrases can also require a passage rewrite.

Respect intentional conversational phrasing, ellipsis and the speaker's voice. Figurative language and unusual images are not defects by themselves; do not impose a preference for plainness. Do not summarize the story or assess its overall design. Do not invent a problem to fill the form: return an empty findings array when the wording works.

Write response text in output_language. Preserve quoted anchors and identifiers exactly. Preserve the facts and the intended meaning when requesting changes.
